863.text: 30 s: construct limit 6, constructs placed during it have no cooldown, and every construct pulses an absorb of 8% HP to allies within 8 yd every 3 s; cd 180 s.

901.text: 1.5 s cast, 30 yd: the target flees 15 s / 6 s (damage may break it); cd 20 s.

902.text: Trade 15% HP for 1 soul shard or a full mana bar; cd 10 s.

903.note: On the crosshair's ally or yourself; up 2 s after going down.
903.text: Spend 1 shard to place a soulstone on yourself or an ally for 15 min: when they go down (or die) they may stand up at 40% HP. One active per warlock; cd 15 min.

911.identity: Hits 1.6x as hard as its spell says.
911.text: 40 yd: 1.5 %EH/s for 18 s; a Malediction stack; cd 3 s.

912.text: 20 s: 20% less bullet damage; cd 30 s.

913.text: Spend 20 Life Force: a corpse within 30 yd rises as a skeleton warrior for 60 s (max 3 minions; low damage, draws fire); cd 3 s.

921.text: 30 yd: 40% slower, no sprint, slower ADS for 12 s; a Malediction stack; cd 8 s.

922.identity: Charging through fire: 50% fewer bullets for 2.5 s after it.
922.text: Leap up to 25 yd; landing deals 10 %EH within 6 yd and stuns 1 s; cd 20 s.

923.note: Needs a corpse or a minion within 30 yd.
923.text: Spend 15 Life Force: a corpse or your own minion within 30 yd explodes, 20 %EH within 8 yd; cd 6 s.

931.identity: Hits 1.6x as hard as its spell says.
931.text: Channel 5 s, 30 yd: 3 %EH/s and you heal 100% of it (200% if Doomed); cd 10 s.

932.note: The burn has no fire of its own to see.
932.text: 10 s: burn enemies within 10 yd for 3 %EH/s while you lose 1% HP/s; you can move; cd 20 s.

933.text: Spend 20 Life Force: absorb 25% of your HP for 20 s; each living minion adds 5%; cd 20 s.

941.text: Up to 5 enemies within 10 yd flee 8 s / 4 s; cd 40 s.

942.identity: Hits 1.3x as hard as its spell says.
942.text: 30 yd: horror 3 s, 15 %EH, heal for the damage; cd 45 s.

943.text: Spend 30 Life Force: a corpse rises as a ghoul for 60 s that leaps 20 yd onto your target and claws (5 %EH/s); minion cap 5; cd 10 s.

951.note: Spreads when you land the killing blow.
951.text: When a target with your afflictions dies, all of them jump to the 2 nearest enemies within 15 yd and you gain a soul shard and 10% HP.

952.text: You take 15% less damage of every kind.

953.text: Life Force cap 150; minions explode for 10 %EH within 6 yd when they die; kills within 20 yd of a minion give +10 Life Force.

961.note: Spreads when you land the killing blow.
961.text: 30 yd: after 10 s the target takes 60 %EH unless the curse is purged; if it dies, Doom spreads every affliction to all enemies within 15 yd; a Malediction stack; cd 60 s.

962.text: Become a demon for 30 s: +50% max HP, claws cleave 15 %EH, Fel Leap has no cooldown, immune to fear and slows; cd 180 s.

963.text: Spend 80 Life Force: stitch an abomination from up to 3 corpses for 45 s: big, slow, tanky, with a Meat Hook (pull an enemy 30 yd, cd 12 s); does not count toward the minion cap; cd 120 s.
